event_text: Strata Energy identifies a cybersecurity incident affecting the plant and wellfield control systems at Lance and shuts down operations as a precaution
notes: The Nov 23 filing dates the incident to late Friday night Western Australia time; the Nov 25 update says the morning of Nov 20 in the US. Both refer to the same day.

event_text: Peninsula asks the Australian Securities Exchange for a trading halt and says the breach was to its operating system only
Wyoming's Department of Environmental Quality says it has not been notified
Peninsula says operations at Lance remain suspended, with no restart date, and its shares are suspended until Nov 30 at the latest
